headline: Which investment instrument earned the most in September? TÜİK data announced
summary: TÜİK data show domestic government debt securities (DİBS) posted the highest monthly real return in September, while BIST 100, gold, euro and dollar investments recorded real losses.
why: Real returns compare instrument performance against inflation, which is central to assessing Turkey's inflation-adjusted investment climate. The Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜİK) publishes the official inflation data used for this calculation.
